changes.result: SourceAgentCatalog consumes the root-owned six-role table and securely captures exact repository descriptor and plugin-manifest bytes through retained candidate-root, .codex, .codex/agents, and .codex-plugin handles. It proves exact bounded name sets for six descriptor entries and one plugin metadata entry before any body read, metadata-probes entries no-follow, and opens only expected filenames.

AgentDiscoverySession combines project, candidate, caller session, exact source catalog, unique private issuance, and unique observation nonce. Atomic states make success, rejection, and replay one-winner outcomes.

The adapter boundary must hold one provenance- and generation-stable transaction while package, installed, cache, global, and discovery catalogs are captured twice and six read-only effect denials are enforced.

Exact non-global closure requires six canonical paths, descriptor bytes, digests, read-only sandbox, source manifest bytes, version, candidate, project, and session. One separator-aware Harness namespace predicate classifies both harness_ and harness- authority before generic descriptor parsing; normalized collisions, unsafe files, extras, omissions, or substitutions remain independently blocked.

Added exact-byte controls for all seven live underscore legacy descriptors, individual one-at-a-time blocking, and a mixed-removal control proving removal of the two additional hyphenated global roles cannot hide any remaining underscore legacy authority.

Replaced path-only source reads with retained FD-anchored no-follow traversal and handle-relative reads. Coordinated agent-root and plugin-root swap/read/restore controls, persistent replacement, final and ancestor symlink controls, outside substitution, and recursive zero-write comparison now fail closed before any substituted bytes can become evidence.

Replaced arbitrary name collection and pre-comparison body reads with an exact bounded directory scanner. It retains at most six expected agent names or one plugin name, aborts on the first unexpected entry, rejects special entries through fstatat without opening them, and validates both directories before opening any source body. A 2,048-extra-entry fixture proves no more than seven agent entries are examined, zero body opens occur, refusal is stable, and the tree remains byte-identical.

Wrapped POSIX readdir in a terminal scanner that clears errno before every call, accepts null only when errno remains zero, and maps EIO, EINTR, and all other enumeration failures to the stable non-echoing unsafe-filesystem error. Deterministic agent and plugin prefix faults prove complete-looking prefixes cannot become EOF, EINTR is not retried, zero body opens and writes occur, and post-error probes never invoke readdir again.

No public receipt or prebuilt observation acceptance path exists. Fixture success remains claim_effect false; source, package, install, cache, catalog, digest, and version proxies cannot replace the same-session host transaction.
